note: The attacker controls the raw bytes that will be parsed as EXIF metadata.
The loader accepts the attacker bytes and accumulates them for EXIF parsing.
After the EXIF directory is parsed, the MakerNote blob is handed to the MakerNote interpreter.
The code fetches the raw MakerNote entry from the parsed EXIF data.
Identification dispatches directly to the Olympus variant probe using the attacker-controlled MakerNote bytes and length.
The probe only guards the first branch with a size check, then continues with format-specific byte tests.
When the MakerNote begins with Nikon, the code reads buf[6] to classify the variant; this is the memory-safety sink if the buffer is shorter than expected.
